findings: Original WLDRVX8 GDS has A, Z, VDD!, VSS! text on Metal1 datatype 2. Upstream layers_definitions reads datatype 25 only. The isolated original extraction contains four matching MOS but no named ports.

The reader-only diagnostic exposes all four labels, preserving their exact spelling and location. Its circuit still matches but strict deck verdict remains FAIL: power labels retain VDD!/VSS! while the reference ports are VDD/VSS. No name override or ignored-port option applied.
Sense-amplifier power labels already lie on datatype 25, including two distinct VDD! labels. The demonstrated pin-reader change alone cannot claim to resolve its separate extracted supply nets.

An exact isolated sg13g2_inv_1 GDS tree against its verbatim independent vendor CDL passes the unmodified updated deck and database auditor. This is an independent positive control, not comparison against an extracted self-reference.
Removing exactly the NMOS line from a disposable inverter reference produces a FAIL from the same unchanged deck and auditor, despite raw CLI exit zero. Original reference remains intact.

preparation_scripts.prepare_stdcell_lvs_control.py:
from pathlib import Path
import re,json,hashlib
import klayout.db as db
root=Path.cwd();b=root/'hw/soc/out/external-review-20260919';out=b/'stdcell-inverter-repro';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);pdk=Path('/home/hasanmelih/.ciel/ihp-sg13g2').resolve();cell='sg13g2_inv_1';gds=pdk/'libs.ref/sg13g2_stdcell/gds/sg13g2_stdcell.gds';cdl=pdk/'libs.ref/sg13g2_stdcell/cdl/sg13g2_stdcell.cdl'
source=db.Layout();source.read(str(gds));selected=source.cell(cell);assert selected is not None
minimal=db.Layout();minimal.dbu=source.dbu;top=minimal.create_cell(cell);top.copy_tree(selected);assert top.bbox()==selected.bbox();minimal.write(str(out/'inv.gds'))
text=cdl.read_text();parts=re.findall(r'^\.SUBCKT '+re.escape(cell)+r'\s[^\n]*\n.*?^\.ENDS[^\n]*',text,re.M|re.S);assert len(parts)==1
header=text.split('.SUBCKT',1)[0];assert 'Apache License' in header
(out/'inv.cdl').write_text(header+parts[0]+'\n')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();(out/'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Exact selected vendor GDS cell tree and verbatim CDL subcircuit plus original licence. No geometry, pin, model or rule edits. Independent real standard-cell positive control, not a SRAM or product pass.','cell':cell,'dbu':source.dbu,'bbox':str(top.bbox()),'source':{str(p):sha(p) for p in [gds,cdl]},'outputs':{str(p):sha(p) for p in [out/'inv.gds',out/'inv.cdl']}},indent=2)+'\n');print('Prepared exact cell/subcircuit subset')
